gloss: to relay; to transfer (a call); to act as intermediary

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {取次|とりつ}ぎませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {取次|とりつ}いでいなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {取次|とりつ}いでいませんでした

definitions.gloss: to relay; to pass on (a message or visitor)
definitions.explanation: To serve as an intermediary by passing a message, request, or visitor along to the intended person.
To connect a caller to another person by transferring the call. A standard action in office and business phone etiquette.

examples.japanese: お{客様|きゃくさま}を{取次|とりつ}いでください。
{伝言|でんごん}を{取次|とりつ}いでもらえますか。
examples.english: Could you relay a message for me?

examples.japanese: {受付|うけつけ}で{名前|なまえ}を{伝|つた}えたら、すぐに{担当者|たんとうしゃ}に{取次|とりつ}いでくれた。
examples.english: When I gave my name at reception, they promptly connected me with the person in charge.

examples.japanese: {電話|でんわ}を{取次|とりつ}ぐ。
{田中|たなか}さんに{電話|でんわ}を{取次|とりつ}いでいただけますか。
examples.english: Could you transfer me to Mr. Tanaka?

examples.japanese: {新入社員|しんにゅうしゃいん}がまず{覚|おぼ}えるべきことの{一|ひと}つは、{電話|でんわ}の{取次|とりつ}ぎ{方|かた}だ。
examples.english: One of the first things new employees should learn is how to transfer phone calls.

notes:
USAGE:
{取次|とりつ}ぐ is a transitive godan verb commonly encountered in business and office settings. The noun form {取次|とりつ}ぎ is also frequently used.

ASPECT (ている):
{取次|とりつ}いでいる describes the ongoing act of relaying or transferring.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {人|ひと}を{取次|とりつ}ぐ (relay/connect a person)
- {電話|でんわ}を{取次|とりつ}ぐ (transfer a call)
- {人|ひと}に{取次|とりつ}ぐ (transfer to someone)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電話|でんわ}を{取次|とりつ}ぐ (transfer a phone call)
- {来客|らいきゃく}を{取次|とりつ}ぐ (show a visitor through)
- {取次|とりつ}ぎ{販売|はんばい} (wholesale distribution)

The noun form {取次|とりつ}ぎ also refers to a distributor or wholesaler in the publishing industry.
